response.justification: Despite a strong full-stack and open-source background, the candidate has minimal demonstrable C++ experience beyond a brief role at National Instruments over a decade ago, with no evidence of modern C++/STL, multi-threading, message brokers, IEC 62443, or industrial automation systems — all core requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across diverse technologies and domains
Strong open-source contributions and technical documentation skills
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and create educational content
concerns: Lacks recent or substantial C++ development experience required for the role
No evidence of industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) or IoT/industrial protocols
Primary tech stack is JavaScript/TypeScript and DLang, not C++ or cloud-native industrial platforms
